outline.unique_angle: Every top-ranking page treats AI as a text generator and stops at the chat window. None address the destination platform. This article is built on the failure mode they ignore: OWNA's fields above the orange line have locked Field Mapping (confirmed in OWNA's own help center), so pasting structured AI output triggers a save/sync error. The concrete, reproducible 'draft-outside, hand-condense-in' workflow — and the specific two-error lived anecdote — is the gap. Includes a real screenshot of an OWNA save error and a before/after of one field.
